# ui::ClassicCaption

Header: `winui/ui/themes/ClassicPalette.hpp`.

A classic scheme's title bars and window borders: what a window under `Frame::Themed` draws its caption and frame with. Windows 98 added the gradient pair; a scheme without one has both ends of each caption the same color.

Example: 
```cpp
// A header strip in Windows 2000's active caption colors: white on navy `#0A246A`, the
// left end of a gradient whose right end is `#A6CAF0`.
const ui::ClassicPalette  scheme  = ui::ClassicPalette::windows_standard_2000();
const ui::ClassicCaption& caption = *scheme.caption;
window.set_content(ui::Border{
    .background = caption.active,
    .padding    = ui::Symmetric{.horizontal = 8.0f, .vertical = 4.0f},
    .content    = ui::Text{.text = "Display Properties", .foreground = caption.text},
});
```

| Field | Type | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `active` | `Color` |  | The active window's caption, at its left end. |
| `gradient_active` | `Color` |  | The active caption's right end. |
| `inactive` | `Color` |  | An inactive window's caption, at its left end. |
| `gradient_inactive` | `Color` |  | The inactive caption's right end. |
| `text` | `Color` |  | The active window's title text. |
| `inactive_text` | `Color` |  | An inactive window's title text. |
| `active_border` | `Color` |  | The active window's sizing frame. |
| `inactive_border` | `Color` |  | An inactive window's sizing frame. |
| `button_cell` | `float` | `18.0f` | The scheme's caption button cell, in pixels at 96 DPI: 18 in Windows Standard, 20 in High Contrast Black. The caption is a pixel taller than this, and a caption button is 2 pixels narrower and 4 shorter. |
